call_points.text: Hoshiarpur 60,000 CBM per annum plywood plant expected to commence operations in Q3FY27.
Chennai plywood capacity to rise from 10,000 CBM per month in Q2 to 12,500 CBM per month from Q3FY27.
UP plywood plant expected by April 2028, subject to land receipt; MDF project in UP to lag plywood.
Particle board margins to rise steadily, targeting close to 15% next year.
No large capex planned; cash flow to go towards debt repayment, targeting long-term debt within EBITDA.
MDF price hike of close to 15% largely rolled back as raw material prices moved.
Logistics business generating positive EBITDA and cash flow; company open to a strategic partner at beneficial valuation.
Industry took a 15% price increase in MDF to counter chemical cost inflation.
Hoshiarpur plant is scheduled to come up in October this year.
EBITDA margin excluding forex rose to 13.7% in Q4 from 12.6% in Q3 and 12.1% a year ago.
FY26 EBITDA margin excluding forex rose to 13.0% from 11.1% in FY25.
Plywood FY26 total income rose 15.6% with EBITDA margin excluding forex at 15.2%.
MDF FY26 total income rose 25.6% with EBITDA margin excluding forex improving to 12.7% from 10.1%.
Capital work in progress fell to ₹179.58 Cr from ₹729.87 Cr as the Andhra Pradesh MDF and laminates projects were capitalised.
Forex loss in FY26 was ₹57.28 Cr against ₹7.29 Cr in FY25, including ₹24.19 Cr in Q4.

timeline.summary: Vishnu Khemani, Sudha Khemani, Nikhil Khemani, and Madanlal Vishnu Prasad (HUF) declared no encumbrances on Century Plyboards (India) Ltd. shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).

Rajesh Kumar Agarwal, Bhawna Agarwal, Hari Prasad Agarwala & Others (HUF), Sumitra Devi Agarwal, Brijdham Merchants Pvt. Ltd., Tanishqa Agarwal, and Vanshika Agarwal declared no encumbrance on Century Plyboards shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 01.04.2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,492.21 Cr (+24.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹78.08 Cr (+48.8% YoY).
Century Plyboards (India) Ltd’s Board, chaired by **SUNDEEP SUNDEEP JHUNJHUNWALA**, recommended ₹1 dividend per equity share for FY2026 on May 22, 2026.

Century Plyboards' 22 May 2026 investor presentation reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,492 Cr (+24.5% YoY) and FY26 revenue of ₹5,397.18 Cr (+19.2%), with EBITDA margin excluding forex at 13.0% for FY26.
Century Plyboards (India) Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on 25 May 2026 via its website.
Century Plyboards held its Q4FY26 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 25, 2026, reporting record revenue and outlining expansion plans.
Century Plyboards' step-down subsidiary Century Adhesives & Chemicals started commercial production at its new resin unit in Naidupetta, Andhra Pradesh on 28 May 2026.
Sanjay Agarwal, Promoter, and Promoter Group entities declared no encumbrances on Century Plyboards (India) Ltd. shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

On 4 August 2026, Century Plyboards held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹1,561 Cr (up 33.5% YoY) and PAT of ₹83.3 Cr (up 57% YoY), while withdrawing revenue and volume guidance due to volatility.
